method:
Market analytics from the CLEANED layer. Observed vs estimated values are kept separate in the output.
Return_t = P_t/P_{t-1}-1 using consecutive PRIMARY-calendar days only; NaN (never filled) if either day is missing.
Market model: R_i = a + b*R_m + e over est. window [-250,-31] (reaction-day-relative trading days), excluding days inside [-20,+20] of OTHER events.
AR = R_i - (a + b*R_m);  CAR = sum AR;  t = CAR / (sigma_e * sqrt(L)) with sigma_e the residual st. dev. (n-2 d.o.f.).
